description: Registered 28 March 1980 as CCCP-12165; served with the Soviet Military Transport Aviation 194th Guards Military Transport Regiment based at Fergana; handed to the Uzbek Air Force 1992-93 and re-registered simply 12165; plinthed beside the House of Officers in Fergana in the early 2000s; no build date is stated by the source so year_built is left blank
